bearer.description: The operator token, an agent key (cta_...) for /v1/memory and the agent plugin/heartbeat routes, or an OAuth 2.1 access token when an issuer is configured (see /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource).

info.description: Append-only memory, source-linked recall and observed outcomes. Bearer agent keys bind the owner scope; a request cannot replace its principal's context. Retrieved evidence never authorizes an action. Use HTTPS for hosted gateways; localhost is intended for a trusted local operator.
info.title: CommonTrace gateway

servers.description: Local gateway; configure HTTPS for hosting
